summary: accounts-forms fetches and executes a remote binary on require via obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: On require('accounts-forms'), index.js loads _polyfill.js, which selects an OS/arch, downloads a native binary over HTTPS from string-split-obfuscated Cloudflare Workers subdomains (oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev, cf100-416.workers.dev, cf103-070.workers.dev, cf102-baf.workers.dev) with a DNS-TXT fallback channel under *.dl.well1.site (numbered TXT records base64-reassembled), writes the payload to a disguised path in /tmp or %TEMP% (analytics_state, dotnet_diag_*.exe,.cache_*), chmods it 0755, and spawns it detached via /bin/sh -c '<file> &' or cmd /c start. Destination hostnames are assembled at runtime via.join('') from split fragments and require('child_'+'process') / fs['chmod'+'Sync'] are constructed by concatenation to defeat static analysis. A second copy of the same dropper primitives is bundled at lib/telemetry.js — not reachable from index.js in this version but structurally identical (base64 chunk decode, chmod 755, detached shell spawn).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
